RPSC Factories & Boiler Inspector Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the admit card for the post of Factories & Boiler Inspector. This recruitment was released for 13 posts. Applications for the RPSC Factories & Boiler Inspector Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 14 December 2025, to 12 January 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 19 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their RPSC Factories & Boiler Inspector Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 December 2025
  • Last Date : 12 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 12 January 2026
  • Exam Date : 19 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 12 September 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, BC, MBC (CL) : Rs. 600/-
  • MBC, BC (NCL), EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 400/-
  • Error Correction Charges : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
